title: Errors and result handling
preamble:
# Errors and result handling

libds's error model as an integrator meets it. Every public function
returns `ds_result_t`; this doc explains the shape, the codes you will see,
their detail-string lifetime, and how errors propagate through callbacks and the
pump.

## What this is not

- Not the impl-side error spec — that is
  [IERR], the
  source of truth for the full taxonomy and runtime invariants.
